signal: Vision Group Retail unified its retail solutions under one brand in December 2025 after acquiring Hivery, Maxerience, and SMSB, combining image recognition, planogram, and assortment science into one platform.

email.subject1: a signal play for Vision Group
email.body1:
Jason, saw Vision Group unified its portfolio under one brand after the Hivery, Maxerience, and SMSB acquisitions.

Pulling several products into one platform usually means a wider set of CPG and retail accounts to cover, and right after a rebrand the list grows faster than the team can touch. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Vision Group off your acquisition and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jason, quick follow-up for Vision Group.

Post-rebrand, the cross-sell surface across image recognition, planogram, and assortment is huge, but most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number. The gap shows up late, and then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Vision Group needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jason, last bit of proof for Vision Group.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Vision Group's reply rate likely compares to other retail-tech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jason, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating three acquisitions under one brand is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a retail-tech motion? I will tailor it to Vision Group either way.
